title: Partner Modernization Factory challenges
description: The order, scope, time, points and business outcome of each challenge. scripts/check-content-invariants.mjs checks the challenge pages, the challenges overview and the scoring rubric against this file.

challenges.title: Define the opportunity
challenges.objective: Connect customer problems and triggers to prioritized business outcomes, map each outcome to a CAF category and a concrete solution, and define KPIs you can measure later in the hackathon.

challenges.title: Secure, AI-ready foundation
challenges.objective: Be able to verify and explain a landing zone: its management groups, hub, policies, exemptions and connectivity.

challenges.title: Assess the source
challenges.objective: Be able to triage migration assessment findings and tell an expected, self-inflicted finding from a real blocker.

challenges.title: Choose target states
challenges.objective: Be able to record a decision as an architecture decision record (ADR) with its alternative and consequence, and to track the work you are consciously not doing yet.

challenges.title: Deploy the CoE archetype with APEX
challenges.objective: Be able to adapt and deploy a reference platform into a governed spoke, and check that it is private and policy-compliant.

challenges.title: Modernize with GHCP
challenges.objective: Be able to drive the Upgrade agent task by task, check its output, and package the result as a container image.

challenges.title: Migrate and go live
challenges.objective: Be able to migrate a database online with the MI link, validate the replica, cut over safely, and bring the app up on the new platform.

challenges.title: Validate the pattern
challenges.objective: Be able to validate a migrated workload with a repeatable pack and record each result with evidence.

challenges.title: Optimize the DB with GHCP
challenges.objective: Be able to find the worst queries in Query Store, fix the cause with Copilot's help, and show the before and after.

challenges.title: Package, hand over, review AI readiness
challenges.objective: Be able to package a reusable asset, complete a handover, and assess how ready a customer is to run GitHub Copilot's agents unattended.
